title: 20-story core and frame
purpose: A 90 ft square, 20-story concrete building: perimeter and interior moment frames round a 24 ft core of 1 ft walls (1,440 wall elements), rigid floors, self-weight, an inverted-triangle lateral load and nine modes. Statics fix the weight, base shear and overturning; periods, drifts and core pier forces are compared.

settings.mass: 1,200 kip per floor as joint masses at the 16 columns; no element mass
settings.endOffsets: off (ETABS automatic end length offsets disabled, forces reported joint to joint)
settings.shells: core walls Shell-Thin, 4 x 4 ft elements
settings.piers: each core wall its own pier

notes: Square plan: modes 1 and 2 are an X/Y pair with equal periods, so their mass ratios are arbitrary.
